caption:
Your birth details never leave your device when you compute your Janam Kundali.

Preparing for a rishta often involves checking birth charts, but sensitive information should stay under your control. RishtaPatra offers three products: biodata maker, Rishta Connect (matchmaking), and Janam Kundali (free).

With our astrology tool, Janam Kundali is computed client-side: the astrology engine runs in the browser, so no request carries birth data anywhere else.

Note: Kundali calculations are indicative; consult your pandit.

Visit rishtapatra.com to explore Janam Kundali on your device.
